text:
Mathieu Olivier is one goal from 50 for his career and stuck on 49. He has gone eight games without a point and without a goal, on 3.2 expected over that stretch (expected goals measure the quality of chances), and he left Thursday's game early. Our numbers say this is mostly bad luck: three goals on 5.6 expected for the season, and Columbus has scored about 6.9 fewer goals than its chances with him on the ice.

The rest of his game is working. The Blue Jackets take 52% of the five-on-five expected goals with him on, five points better than without him, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking puts him in the 84th percentile for chances from in front of the net. He also has 60 hits. Undrafted, from Biloxi, Mississippi, he scored 15 goals last season and earned a real role. Our range has him around 17 goals. The 50th should not be far off, and the Devils are next.
